buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Note to the seller This is a Proprietary item of OEM M/s.Shinkawa Electric Company Ltd, M/s.Forbes Marshall Private Limited i s an authorised dealer of the OEM. Hence offer from other firms will not be considered for evaluation. 2. General Guarantee for Warranty - Applicable General Guarantee for Warranty for the supplied materials shall be valid for a period of 12 months from th e date of commissioning or 18 months from the date of receipt of material, whichever is earlier. To be furnished in Non-Judicial Stamp Paper not less than Rs.80/- as per the format available in NLCIL Web site. ADDRESS: GGW shall be sent to The Chief General Manager/MMC, NLC India Ltd., Block-27, Neyveli - 607 807. 3. Combined Bank Guarantee

Combined Bank Guarantee is applicable for the period mentioned in the bid. We confirm to submit a Bank guarantee on Rs.80/- non-judicial stamp paper for performance of contract fo r 5% of the total order value, within 60 days from the date of purchase order or within delivery period pres cribed in purchase order, whichever is earlier as per bid condition. If the Bank Guarantee is not submitted with in the due date or sent in a different format other than either NLCIL or GeM, NLCIL shall have the opti on, either to reject the Bank Guarantee / Cancel the order at the risk and cost of the seller at the discretio n of NLCIL. The details of beneficiary and its details for issue of BG under SFMS platform is as follows. (a) Name: NLC India Limited, (b) Unit / Area / Division: Materials Management Complex, (c) Beneficiary Bank, Branch &Address: State Bank of India, Block-2, Neyveli-607801, (d) IFSC Code : SBIN0000958. The above particulars are to be incorporated by the issuing bank properly while issuing BG under SFMS mo de. ADDRESS: CBG shall be sent to The Chief General Manager/MMC, NLC India Ltd., Block-27, Neyveli - 607 807. 4. Inspection clause Seller Must agree for Inspection at Neyveli .
